decision.label: Call
decision.value: Bearish tilt across index duration into payroll; keep three defined-risk put-debit spreads and drop the redundant single name.

decision.label: Action
decision.value: Enter QQQ 710/665, SPY 765/745 and IWM 294/280 put-debit spreads on a break below each short-side entry level.

decision.label: Aggression
decision.value: Low-to-moderate — every position is defined-risk with sub-$800 max loss per spread; the real risk is stacking correlated index shorts, so size the book.

decision.label: Why now
decision.value: Rising real yields (DFII10 +12bp to 2.44%) tax duration and VIX is bid to 16.34 into tomorrow's payroll.

decision.label: Max risk
decision.value: Per spread QQQ $774, SPY $400, IWM $343 — treat the combined ~$1,517 as a single correlated debit a strong payroll print stops out together.

decision.label: Invalidation
decision.value: QQQ above 720, SPY above 770, IWM above 297 — each spread dies on a reclaim of its Call Wall.

decision.label: Next trigger
decision.value: Tomorrow's 08:30 ET payroll; entries arm only on a break below QQQ 710 / SPY 765 / IWM 294.

decision.label: Confidence
decision.value: Moderate — no ow_ib_positions call, so existing book exposure and buying-power fit are unverified, and GEX/skew anchors are trusted from the design layer.

sections.title: Rates are the first cause, and this time the levels line up
sections.body: Yesterday stood down: both bearish spreads carried 'above' invalidations spot had already touched — SPY 773.16 against spot 773.18, QQQ 717.465 against spot 717.53 — so each opened through its own stop. What changed is not the direction but the entry geometry.

sections.title: The most anomalous move is vol divorcing from a green tape
sections.body: VIXCLS jumped from 14.92 (08-31) to 16.34 (09-01), +1.42 vol points, its sharpest one-day rise in the 30-day window, while the 10Y made new local highs and spot held green. The bar it faced was August's pinned 14-handle (14.25 on 08-14, 14.43 on 08-28) on the assumption the Fed path was benign.

sections.title: The beat-and-raise-that-closed-down tag is left unassigned
sections.body: The label needs the beat, the raise and the red close verified together, and this run has none of the three. The headline feed (ow_uw_headlines, newest 2026-09-03T16:58:01Z) carried no watchlist earnings beat — the tape was M&A and geopolitics, including an $AAPL £2B London suit at 2026-09-03T16:17:51Z over App Tracking Transparency.

sections.title: Reaction function: the market is waiting on 08:30 ET, not the speakers
sections.body: Cleveland's Hammack and Chicago's Goolsbee speak at 15:00 ET / 2026-09-03T19:00:00Z, but the function is already written into the strip. Frenzy's futures-implied path (snapshot 2026-09-02, NOT CME FedWatch) puts 16 September at 60% HIKE 25bp / 40% Hold, implied 3.78%; October flips to 70% Hold; December swings back to 64% HIKE, implied 4.015%. It is asymmetric around one input.

sections.title: Scenarios: base case is the hot print, held loosely because the crowd is opposite
sections.body: Path A — hot payroll (>+50k or AHE M/M ≥0.3%): rates lead, DGS10 pushes off 4.79% toward 4.85–4.90% as the September hike firms past 60%, and the duration tax lands on QQQ (717.47) and the megacap complex first, IWM (294.93) via floating-rate liabilities second, VIX gapping from 16.34 toward 18–19 last.

candidates.rationale: Highest-duration index and the cleanest expression of the real-yield thesis (DFII10 +12bp to 2.44%), with VIX bid into tomorrow's payroll.

Index anchor with NORMAL put-skew and a validated -2.6%/20d separation. Long the 765 Put Wall / Accel-down level (~1% below spot 772.87) — losing it flips dealers short-gamma with the 766 flip just above; the 745 short caps cost.
Genuinely differentiated driver: small caps carry floating-rate liability sensitivity to the real-rate back-up, and argon flags RICH put-skew (rr_z +0.66) with a validated -3.9%/20d separation.
